sources.authority: Government of India, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.document: S.O. 4294(E) dated 03.10.2023 adding Dicofol, Dinocap and Methomyl, as shown in the Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine and Storage list effective 31.03.2024 (49 pesticides banned for manufacture, import and use)

notes: Items are the 49 pesticides banned for manufacture, import and use. Captafol and Nicotin Sulfate are banned for use. Carbofuran is blocked in every formulation although a 3 percent CG formulation remains registered. Monocrotophos is blocked because it is banned on vegetables and its 36 percent SL registrations were cancelled. Names in aliases are alternative spellings. Names of fewer than five letters are not listed because matching is by substring.
